items.markdown: Table 20. Comparison among commonly used resampling schemes with their calibration parameters. The computational complexity is analysed per sample which can be embarrassingly parallelised over the samples. The complexity of OT is given by Luo et al. (2023a), where we here parametrise the Sinkhorn precision with the regularisation parameter $\varepsilon$ to unify comparison. By “fully differentiable” we mean that the pathwise gradient is well defined, for instance, the soft resampling is only partially differentiable.
